mods.reason: Astral Chain loads one mod that you pick in its launcher from a mods folder next to its work folder, and Graft can't manage that folder yet.

files.label: Game app
files.summary: The Mac app MacNativeGames built for Astral Chain.
files.detail: Play opens this app. It's named Astral Chain.app, and MacNativeGames builds it in games/alc in your MacNativeGames folder, or copies it to /Applications or ~/Applications when you install it. The app is small: it runs the game from the work folder it was built from, so keep that folder where it is.

files.label: Base game
files.summary: Your copy of the game: the XCI card image you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: The card image holds both the base game and the 1.0.1 update, and MacNativeGames reads the game's code and data from it. Reading it needs the keys from your Switch.

files.label: Work folder
files.summary: The folder MacNativeGames worked in when it built the game app.
files.detail: It's named AC_build inside games/alc in your MacNativeGames folder unless you chose another name when building. The game app records where it is and runs the game from it.
